name: eval
description: Swarmail's eval recipe, interim path (decision 0116, recording the operator's 2026-10-18 rulings on #148): one exec trial seat that runs the opaque eval-trial driver (swarmail-evals trial, which starts Swarmail and the fixture as its own children and runs the real brokkr driver claude|codex|dsh as a child so the journal keeps tokens, turns and tool rows), then one exec scoring gate that re-applies the task's check to the app's retained state and never reads the agent's account. Nothing in the trial seat is confined: every result is recorded as unconfined. No retries: a retried trial is a different experiment. The recipe moves to the MCP broker when brokkr#766 lands.
